canonicalScope: The execution interpretation of the 53 accepted CLOSURE obligations, and nothing else. This file is not the dependency source of truth: 08-DEPENDENCY-OVERLAY.tsv is, and every edge below is a derived projection of it pinned by hash.
supersessionNote: No byte of the P00 package is changed, copied or re-issued by this addendum. RCPT-00 and its evidence stay valid exactly as issued. What this file corrects is forward-only and narrow: the execution reading of one sentence that, taken literally, made every phase exit receipt unreachable. The historical sentence is preserved verbatim below and is never edited in place.

correctedSentence.historicalText: This phase may not produce its exit receipt while any listed obligation is unsatisfied.
correctedSentence.defectUnderLiteralReading: Read literally against 53 edges whose destinations all sit in the same phase or a later one, this sentence makes every phase exit receipt with a closure obligation unreachable, and with it every successor phase.
correctedSentence.forwardOnlyExecutionReading: A CLOSURE obligation blocks the final CLOSED state of its source gap. It does not block the source phase receipt when its destination receipt does not exist yet. The phase receipt and the gap's final closure are two different facts and are recorded separately from here on.
whatIsNotCorrected: no readiness, release, deploy, production or gapClosed flag
no phase order, no noSkip rule and no human gate
no historical byte, hash, receipt or review verdict

sourcePins.verificationRule: If the evidence root is present, every pinned file must be present and byte-exact or this package is RED. If the whole root is absent the checker reports externalEvidence=absent and never reports it as verified.

p00Receipt.note: Pinned so that a later reader can prove this addendum was derived against the receipt as issued. This addendum does not authorise P01 entry either.

independentDeadlockAudit.role: independent read-only audit that produced this package's root finding

rootFinding.statement: Under the historical literal reading, no phase carrying a CLOSURE obligation can ever issue its exit receipt, so the chain cannot advance past P00.
evidence: All 53 accepted CLOSURE edges point at the same phase or a later one. Backward edges: 0.
Every phase's commonObligations text forbids producing the phase exit receipt while any source-phase CLOSURE load is undischarged.
P02 and every later phase refuse entry without the predecessor phase receipt, and noSkip is true.

The P00 validator counts and enumerates CLOSURE edges but never graph-checks destination existence, destination phase or executability. Rewriting the five P01 destinations to a nonexistent node left its verdict unchanged.
rootFinding.blindSpotDetail: The routine receives each edge as {edgeId, src, dst} and never reads dst. Destination information is in hand and discarded.

separation.phaseReceipt: Produced when the phase's outputs, gates, review and human decisions are satisfied. It is what a successor consumes for no-skip admission.
separation.gapFinalClosure: A gap reaches CLOSED only when every CLOSURE obligation originating at it is discharged. This is a separate fact from the phase receipt and is never implied by it.
separation.rule: A CLOSURE edge blocks the source gap's final CLOSED state. It never blocks the source phase receipt on the ground that a forward destination receipt does not exist yet.

INTRA_ATOMIC.discharge: Discharged atomically inside the same phase receipt only when both the source and the destination evidence are present in that receipt and every human decision gating either side has been recorded SATISFIED by the authorized human; a decision still OPEN or otherwise unanswered leaves this obligation undischarged, and the reachability simulation's assumption that such a gate is satisfiable is a statement about a decision not yet made rather than that decision, so it signs nothing, answers nothing, closes nothing and produces no receipt.

FORWARD_DEFERRED.discharge: Recorded in the source phase receipt as an append-only open debt carrying edgeId, sourceGap, destinationGap, destinationPhase and expectedDestinationReceipt. The source gap stays CLOSURE_PENDING and may not be reported CLOSED.
FORWARD_DEFERRED.dischargedBy: A separate append-only CLOSURE_DISCHARGE receipt issued when the destination phase receipt is published. It binds sourcePhaseReceiptHash, destinationPhaseReceiptHash and edgeId. The source phase receipt is never rewritten.

BACKWARD_REFUSED.reason: No such edge exists in the accepted set, and the P00 rule GR-CLOSURE-MINIMAL already refuses one. A backward closure edge would be a PREREQ edge mislabelled.

humanGatePolicy.scope: Keeps two facts apart that a single earlier sentence ran together: the human-decision state a real discharge requires, and the assumption a reachability run is permitted to make. Neither one is ever the other.

successorAdmission.doesNotWaitFor: the future gap closures of the whole programme
successorAdmission.humanGateHandling: Human and external gates are treated as satisfiable but never auto-closed. The simulation shows a receipt is reachable; it never signs one.

phaseChainProjection.derivationRule: One row per phase of 00-PHASE-CHAIN.json, in chain order, carrying only the fields the execution projection needs. No field is invented and no field is edited.
